structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or

By which date must the Commission submit the second specific report on the assessment of Article 6(4) and (5) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, provided for in Article 53(3)?

response.text: By what date is the Commission required to present the second specific report, under Article 53(3), evaluating Article 6(4) and (5) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?
